description:
Who owns / is behind an LLC or corporation, from official sources. `mode='name'`: `query` is the business name
        (e.g. 'ESRT Empire State Building LLC'); `mode='address'`: `query` is a street address and the owner of record there
        is looked up first (NYC, rest of New York State, Philadelphia, Illinois, Texas, Utah County), then the entity.
        `state` (two letters, optional) limits the registry search to one state; registries searched: NY, TX, PA, CO, CT, OR
        (official open data). Returns: registry `records` (status, formation date, entity type, principal office, registered
        agent, officers/principals where the state publishes them, link to the official record), and `properties` recorded to
        that exact entity name in NYC ACRIS (deeds, mortgages), NYC HPD registrations, NY State assessment rolls, Philadelphia
        OPA and Illinois PTAX-203 transfer declarations (with the declared signer's title). People appear only as initials.
        New York does not publish LLC members; Florida (Sunbiz) is not searched automatically (its link is returned).
        Refuses a person's name: business entities only.
name: llc_owner_lookup
